name: one server's health is reported by its ref key
description: GET /api/db/servers/:ref/health probes the single node whose key matches, addressed by the refKey (host:port) that GET /api/db/servers hands out. The response is one ServerRef, not an array. The refKey is the stable identifier Phorge uses for the same server, so the path is a contract: db1:3306 is the seeded master.
